dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what subjects do you study this year?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt ˈsʌbdʒɪkts duː juː ˈstʌdi ðɪs ˈjɪr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Math and science? But you study English!
dialogue.reading: ˈmæθ ənd ˈsaɪəns? bʌt juː ˈstʌdi ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. But every student has to study math and science.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. bʌt ˈɛvri ˈstuːdənt ˈhæs tə ˈstʌdi ˈmæθ ənd ˈsaɪəns.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not really. It's difficult, but I have to study it.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. ɪts ˈdɪfɪkəlt, bʌt aɪ ˈhæf tə ˈstʌdi ɪt.
